articles.title: Invisible Bumper Cars in Space? New Dark Matter Idea Solves 3 Big Mysteries
articles.summary: Imagine invisible stuff that usually ignores itself suddenly starts bumping around. Scientists think this 'self-interacting dark matter' could explain a super-dense clump, a scar in a star stream, and a weird star cluster. It's like a crowd that goes from polite to pushy.

articles.title: A Tiny Repair Crew in Your Blood? New Material Heals Hearts from the Inside
articles.summary: Scientists made a special powder that turns into a healing gel when mixed with water. Injected into the bloodstream, it finds damaged heart tissue after a heart attack and helps fix it from the inside out. Tests on rats and pigs showed less scarring and better heart function.

articles.title: A 240-Million-Year-Old Monster Was Hiding in a Garden Wall!
articles.summary: A retired chicken farmer found a fossil while building a garden wall. It turned out to be a 1.2-meter-long amphibian that lived 240 million years ago. Named Arenaerpeton, it had gnarly teeth and fang-like tusks, and looked like a giant salamander but much heavier.
